description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AnySoftKeyboardThemeOverlay' that manages theme overlays for the AnySoftKeyboard app. It handles theme changes, overlay data creation, and application of overlays to the keyboard view, including remote app color overrides and theme switching.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardThemeOverlay
classes.description: An abstract class managing theme overlays for the keyboard, handling theme changes, overlay creation, and application.

classes.name: EmptyOverlayData
classes.description: A static inner class representing invalid or empty overlay data.

classes.name: ToggleOverlayCreator
classes.description: A class implementing overlay data toggling between override and original data, with owner tracking.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes overlay data creator, observes theme changes, and remote app color preferences.

methods.name: onThemeChanged
methods.description: Handles theme change events, updating the keyboard view container with the new theme and overlay.

methods.name: createOverlayDataCreator
methods.description: Creates and returns an overlay data creator that manages remote app overlays and overrides.

methods.name: onStartInputView
methods.description: Called when input view starts; applies theme overlay based on current input info.

methods.name: applyThemeOverlay
methods.description: Applies overlay data based on the current input info's package.

methods.name: onAddOnsCriticalChange
methods.description: Resets overlay package info upon critical add-on changes.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates the input view, resetting overlay package info and applying current theme and overlay.
